scientific_integrity: All universal assertions have explicit analytic proofs; exhaustive computation is corroborative. Literature overlap and residual priority risks are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to exactly two agents, binary additive values and one irrevocably assigned item each round.
Sharp online ratios are relative to a specified two-sequence adversarial family, yielding global lower bounds but not a characterization of global online minimax ratios.
Randomized ratio is in expectation against an oblivious adversary; exhaustive computations cover horizons at most eight for all value profiles.
Prior-work novelty is assessed from stated inspected sources but independent priority verification has not been performed.
title: The first asymmetric arrival determines optimal temporal envy and the sharp cost of foresight
